Cartographic Visualization with ggplot2

Source: R/plot_d4h.R
d4h_plot.Rd

Plots continuous raster layers or zonal grids using aggregation and geom_raster.

Usage

d4h_plot(
  x,
  grid = NULL,
  houses = NULL,
  houses_filter_extent = FALSE,
  house_color = "red",
  house_size = 2,
  rgb_bands = NULL,
  palette = "viridis",
  limits = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  max_pixels = 5e+05
)

Arguments

x

SpatRaster, SpatVector, sf, or character path to plot.

grid

Optional SpatVector, sf, or character path to overlay grid boundaries.

houses

Optional sf, data.frame, SpatVector, or character path to CSV containing house coordinates. Automatically plotted as red points (or customizable color/size).

houses_filter_extent

Logical. If TRUE, filters houses to only those intersecting the raster extent / footprint. If FALSE (default), shows all houses including surrounding ones.

house_color

Character. Color for house points (default: "red").

house_size

Numeric. Size for house points (default: 2.0).

rgb_bands

Numeric vector of length 3 (e.g. c(1, 2, 3)). If x is a multi-band raster and rgb_bands is specified, renders in true/false RGB.

palette

Character. Color palette name ("viridis", "magma", "terrain") or custom color vector (default: "viridis").

Value

A ggplot object.
